functions.name: createNativeForm
functions.source: function createNativeForm(){var formBlock=document.querySelector(".home-2-form-block.w-form");if(!formBlock||formBlock.getAttribute("data-dv-native-ready")==="true")return;var oldForm=formBlock.querySelector("form");if(!oldForm)return;var form=oldForm.cloneNode(true);oldForm.replaceWith(form);formBlock.setAttribute("data-dv-native-ready","true");var endpoint=formBlock.getAttribute("data-dv-endpoint")||window.DENTVITALIS_FORM_ENDPOINT||"/send";form.classList.add("dv-native-form");form.setAttribute("action",endpoint);form.setAttribute("method","post");form.setAttribute("enctype","multipart/form-data");form.setAttribute("accept-charset","UTF-8");form.removeAttribute("data-name");form.removeAttribute("data-wf-page-id");form.removeAttribute("data-wf-element-id");form.removeAttribute("name");var wrapper=form.querySelector(".home-2-form-wrapper");if(wrapper){wrapper.style.opacity="1";wrapper.removeAttribute("data-w-id")}function configureField(id,name,label,placeholder,type,required){var field=form.querySelector("#"+id);if(!field)return;field.setAttribute("name",name);field.setAttribute("aria-label",label);field.setAttribute("placeholder",placeholder);var autocomplete={name:"given-name",email:"email",phone:"tel"}[name];if(autocomplete)field.setAttribute("autocomplete",autocomplete);if(type)field.setAttribute("type",type);field.required=Boolean(required);if(!required)field.removeAttribute("required");field.removeAttribute("data-name")}var formTitle="Prenota la prima visita gratuita a Rijeka (Fiume), Croazia!";var pageTitle=document.querySelector(".section-contatti .medjunaslov-h2.bijeli");if(pageTitle)pageTitle.textContent=formTitle;var surnameField=form.querySelector("#Last-Name-2");if(surnameField)surnameField.remove();configureField("name-2","name","Nome","*Nome:","text",true);configureField("Email-5","email","E-mail","*E-mail:","email",true);configureField("Phone-2","phone","Telefono","Telefono:","tel",false);var message=form.querySelector("#field-2");if(message){message.setAttribute("name","message");message.setAttribute("aria-label","Messaggio");message.setAttribute("placeholder","Messaggio:");message.required=false;message.removeAttribute("required");message.removeAttribute("data-name")}var privacy=form.querySelector("[data-dv-privacy]");var privacyInput=privacy&&privacy.querySelector("input[type='checkbox']");if(privacyInput){var privacyLabel=privacyInput.closest("label");var privacyCopy=privacyLabel&&privacyLabel.querySelector(".w-form-label");var hiddenConsent=document.createElement("input");hiddenConsent.type="hidden";hiddenConsent.name="form_agreement";hiddenConsent.value="0";privacyInput.parentNode.insertBefore(hiddenConsent,privacyInput);privacyInput.id="dv-privacy-consent";privacyInput.name="form_agreement";privacyInput.value="1";privacyInput.required=true;if(privacyCopy){privacyCopy.innerHTML='Ho letto l\'informativa sulla privacy.'}}var upload=form.querySelector("[data-dv-file-upload]");var fileInput=upload&&upload.querySelector("input[type='file']");var fileName=upload&&(upload.querySelector(".w-file-upload-info")||upload.querySelector("#dv-file-name"));var emptyFileText="Max 8 MB";if(!fileInput){upload=document.createElement("div");upload.className="dv-upload-field";upload.innerHTML=''+'"+''+emptyFileText+"";if(privacy)form.insertBefore(upload,privacy);else form.appendChild(upload);fileInput=upload.querySelector("#dv-file-upload");fileName=upload.querySelector("#dv-file-name")}if(!fileInput.id)fileInput.id="dv-file-upload";fileInput.name="file";fileInput.accept=ACCEPTED_FILES;fileInput.setAttribute("aria-label","Seleziona il file");var existingFileLabel=upload&&upload.querySelector(".dv-file-upload-label");if(existingFileLabel)existingFileLabel.textContent="Seleziona il file";if(fileName)fileName.textContent=emptyFileText;if(fileName){fileName.id="dv-file-name";fileName.setAttribute("aria-live","polite");fileInput.setAttribute("aria-describedby","dv-file-name")}var urlField=document.createElement("input");urlField.type="hidden";urlField.name="url";urlField.value=window.location.href;form.appendChild(urlField);var langField=document.createElement("input");langField.type="hidden";langField.name="lang";langField.value=document.documentElement.lang||"it";form.appendChild(langField);var sourcePageUrlField=document.createElement("input");sourcePageUrlField.type="hidden";sourcePageUrlField.name="source_page_url";form.appendChild(sourcePageUrlField);var sourcePagePathField=document.createElement("input");sourcePagePathField.type="hidden";sourcePagePathField.name="source_page_path";form.appendChild(sourcePagePathField);var sourcePageTitleField=document.createElement("input");sourcePageTitleField.type="hidden";sourcePageTitleField.name="source_page_title";form.appendChild(sourcePageTitleField);var formPlacementField=document.createElement("input");formPlacementField.type="hidden";formPlacementField.name="form_placement";form.appendChild(formPlacementField);function updateSourceFields(){var sourceUrl=new URL(window.location.href);sourceUrl.hash="";sourcePageUrlField.value=sourceUrl.href;sourcePagePathField.value=sourceUrl.pathname;sourcePageTitleField.value=document.title||"";formPlacementField.value=formBlock.closest("#dv-inquiry-modal")?"home_popup":"home_inline"}updateSourceFields();var honeypot=document.createElement("div");honeypot.className="dv-honeypot";honeypot.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");honeypot.innerHTML='';form.appendChild(honeypot);var submitControl=form.querySelector(".gumb-vise");if(submitControl&&submitControl.tagName!=="BUTTON"){var submitButton=document.createElement("button");submitButton.type="submit";submitButton.className=submitControl.className;submitButton.setAttribute("aria-label","Invia la richiesta");submitButton.innerHTML=submitControl.innerHTML;submitControl.replaceWith(submitButton);submitControl=submitButton}if(submitControl){submitControl.removeAttribute("href");submitControl.removeAttribute("style")}var submitWrapper=form.querySelector(".tm-40-button-wrapper");if(submitWrapper)submitWrapper.style.opacity="1";var response=document.createElement("p");response.className="dv-native-form__message";response.hidden=true;response.setAttribute("role","alert");form.appendChild(response);fileInput.addEventListener("change",(function(){var file=fileInput.files&&fileInput.files[0];if(!file){if(fileName)fileName.textContent=emptyFileText;return}if(fileName)fileName.textContent=file.name}));form.addEventListener("submit",(function(event){var file=fileInput.files&&fileInput.files[0];response.hidden=true;urlField.value=window.location.href;updateSourceFields();if(honeypot.querySelector("input").value){event.preventDefault();return}if(file&&file.size>MAX_FILE_BYTES){event.preventDefault();response.textContent="Il file allegato deve essere inferiore a 8 MB.";response.hidden=false;fileInput.focus()}}))}

function initDentVitalisInquiryModal(){if(document.getElementById("dv-inquiry-modal"))return;var legacyMobileTrigger=document.querySelector(".hidden-button .secondary-button.header-button");if(legacyMobileTrigger)legacyMobileTrigger.classList.add("gumb-upit");var triggers=Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll(".gumb-upit"));var homeBookingTrigger=document.querySelector('html[data-wf-page="695e1eeeb10c5fb8eeaba87c"] .section-informazioni a.gumb-vise[href="/informazioni-per-pazienti"]');if(homeBookingTrigger&&triggers.indexOf(homeBookingTrigger)===-1){triggers.push(homeBookingTrigger)}var formBlock=document.querySelector(".home-2-form-block.w-form");if(!triggers.length||!formBlock)return;var form=formBlock.querySelector("form");if(!form)return;var originalParent=formBlock.parentNode;var originalNextSibling=formBlock.nextSibling;var activeTrigger=null;var bodyOverflow="";var modal=document.createElement("div");modal.id="dv-inquiry-modal";modal.setAttribute("role","dialog");modal.setAttribute("aria-modal","true");modal.setAttribute("aria-labelledby","dv-inquiry-modal-title");modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");modal.innerHTML='
'+''+'
'+'

'+'

Prenota la prima visita gratuita a Rijeka (Fiume), Croazia!

";document.body.appendChild(modal);var host=modal.querySelector(".dv-inquiry-modal__form-host");var closeButton=modal.querySelector(".dv-inquiry-modal__close");var nameField=form.querySelector("#name-2");var emailField=form.querySelector("#Email-5");var phoneField=form.querySelector("#Phone-2");var messageField=form.querySelector("#field-2");if(nameField){nameField.setAttribute("placeholder","*Nome:");nameField.setAttribute("aria-label","Nome")}if(emailField){emailField.setAttribute("placeholder","*E-mail:");emailField.setAttribute("aria-label","E-mail")}if(phoneField){phoneField.setAttribute("placeholder","Telefono:");phoneField.setAttribute("aria-label","Telefono")}if(messageField){messageField.setAttribute("placeholder","Messaggio:");messageField.setAttribute("aria-label","Messaggio")}var privacyInput=form.querySelector("[data-dv-privacy] input[type='checkbox']");if(privacyInput){privacyInput.required=true;if(!form.classList.contains("dv-native-form")){privacyInput.name="Privacy consent";privacyInput.value="accepted";privacyInput.id="dv-privacy-consent"}var privacyLabel=privacyInput.closest("label");var privacyCopy=privacyLabel&&privacyLabel.querySelector(".w-form-label");if(privacyCopy&&!privacyCopy.querySelector("a")){privacyCopy.textContent="";privacyCopy.appendChild(document.createTextNode("Ho letto l'"));var privacyLink=document.createElement("a");privacyLink.href="https://www.dentvitalis.com/informativa-sulla-privacy";privacyLink.textContent="informativa sulla privacy.";privacyCopy.appendChild(privacyLink)}}var submitControl=form.querySelector(".gumb-vise");if(submitControl){submitControl.setAttribute("role","button");submitControl.setAttribute("aria-label","Invia la richiesta");submitControl.addEventListener("click",(function(event){event.preventDefault();if(typeof form.requestSubmit==="function"){form.requestSubmit()}}))}function openModal(event){event.preventDefault();activeTrigger=event.currentTarget;host.appendChild(formBlock);bodyOverflow=document.body.style.overflow;document.body.style.overflow="hidden";modal.classList.add("is-open");modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden","false");window.setTimeout((function(){var firstField=form.querySelector("input, textarea");if(firstField)firstField.focus()}),0)}function closeModal(){if(!modal.classList.contains("is-open"))return;if(originalNextSibling&&originalNextSibling.parentNode===originalParent){originalParent.insertBefore(formBlock,originalNextSibling)}else{originalParent.appendChild(formBlock)}document.body.style.overflow=bodyOverflow;modal.classList.remove("is-open");modal.setAttribute("aria-hidden","true");if(activeTrigger)activeTrigger.focus()}triggers.forEach((function(trigger){trigger.addEventListener("click",openModal)}));closeButton.addEventListener("click",closeModal);modal.addEventListener("click",(function(event){if(event.target===modal)closeModal()}));document.addEventListener("keydown",(function(event){if(event.key==="Escape")closeModal()}))}

functions.name: initSection
functions.source: function initSection(section){var queued=false;function getCards(){return Array.prototype.slice.call(section.querySelectorAll(".teaser-copy-wrap"))}function getAllImages(){return Array.prototype.slice.call(section.querySelectorAll(".p-teaser-img-wrap .teaser-img"))}function clearFade(images){section.classList.remove("dv-scroll-fade-ready");images.forEach((function(image){image.style.removeProperty("opacity");image.removeAttribute("data-dv-fade-pair")}))}function syncCardLayout(cards){var logo=document.querySelector(".navbar img");cards.forEach((function(wrap){var card=wrap.querySelector(".home-service-card-hp");if(!card)return;if(window.innerWidth<992||!logo){card.style.removeProperty("--dv-directory-card-width");card.style.removeProperty("--dv-directory-card-offset");return}var wrapRect=wrap.getBoundingClientRect();var width=Math.min(560,Math.round(wrapRect.width));var offset=Math.round(logo.getBoundingClientRect().left-wrapRect.left);card.style.setProperty("--dv-directory-card-width",width+"px");card.style.setProperty("--dv-directory-card-offset",offset+"px")}))}function sync(){queued=false;var cards=getCards();var allImages=getAllImages();syncCardLayout(cards);if(window.innerWidth<992){section.removeAttribute("data-dv-fade-status");clearFade(allImages);return}var images=allImages.filter(isVisibleDesktopImage);section.setAttribute("data-dv-fade-status",cards.length+":"+images.length);if(cards.length<2||cards.length!==images.length){clearFade(allImages);return}var next=0;cards.forEach((function(card,index){var visibleCard=card.querySelector(".home-service-card-hp");var entryTop=(visibleCard||card).getBoundingClientRect().top;card.setAttribute("data-dv-fade-pair",String(index+1));if(Math.floor(entryTop)<=window.innerHeight)next=index}));section.classList.add("dv-scroll-fade-ready");images.forEach((function(image,index){image.setAttribute("data-dv-fade-pair",String(index+1));image.style.setProperty("opacity",index===next?"1":"0","important")}))}function requestSync(){if(queued)return;queued=true;window.requestAnimationFrame(sync)}var observer=new MutationObserver(requestSync);observer.observe(section,{childList:true,subtree:true});window.addEventListener("scroll",requestSync,{passive:true});window.addEventListener("resize",requestSync);window.addEventListener("orientationchange",requestSync);requestSync()}
